beats.summary: Michael recounts his quitting story and his nervousness about entering the wrong building.

evidence.snippet: I get up to the building, I get to the revolving door… broken! So I have to take the normal door.
I looked at Wallace and I said "I quit!" and as I turned to leave I looked back and I said "You have no idea how high I can fly."

beats.summary: Michael's coworkers speculate on what he should have said or done when quitting.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: Did you tell him how sick of him you were?
Angela: Well, wouldn't it feel good to tell him that he was incompetent?

beats.summary: Michael has given his two-week notice and is behaving differently at work.

evidence.snippet: About a week ago, Michael gave his 2-week notice.
And, surprisingly there is a very big difference between Michael trying and Michael not trying.
